goal: Retarget plugins/morphist-tools/skills/prd and plugins/morphist-tools/skills/vision so a workshop writes one openspec/changes/<change-id>/. A PRD lands in that change's proposal.md and, when it has requirements, specs/<capability>/spec.md deltas. A vision lands in that proposal's Why and What, and in design.md only when the vision changes the architecture. Neither skill creates docs/prd-*.md, docs/products/, or docs/vision.md. The next-step line names sprint-plan with the change id, not a docs path. Keep the interview and workshop bodies; replace save paths and next-step lines in place. Old doc-store paths may appear only on a line that forbids them. Check the four implementation boxes in tasks.md. Leave the living-spec fold box open. Do not edit the living spec. Do not fold. Do not change the ACTIVE BUILD banner.
non_goals: Migrate existing docs/prd or docs/products trees

anchors.invariant: PRD and vision seed one change directory. The next step is sprint-plan with that change id.
Save path is still docs/prd or docs/products. That is the code to replace.
Artifact locations are still docs/vision.md and docs/products. That is the code to replace.

acceptance.command: python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; import re,sys; roots=[Path("plugins/morphist-tools/skills/prd"),Path("plugins/morphist-tools/skills/vision")]; bad=re.compile(r"docs/prd-|docs/products/|docs/vision.md"); ok=re.compile(r"not |never |forbid|do not|shall not|must not", re.I); hits=[]; [(hits.append(root.name) if "openspec/changes/" not in (root/"SKILL.md").read_text() else None) for root in roots]; [hits.extend(f"{p}:{i}:{line}" for i,line in enumerate(p.read_text().splitlines(),1) if bad.search(line) and not ok.search(line)) for root in roots for p in root.rglob("*.md")]; sys.exit(chr(10).join(hits)) if hits else print("ok")'
